entities.summary: Arron Fraser Andrew Banks is a British businessman, political donor, and Reform UK politician. He was the co-founder of the Leave.EU campaign. Banks was previously one of the largest donors to the UK Independence Party (UKIP) and helped Nigel Farage's campaign for Britain to leave the EU.
